model.intro: Set the master category once; all other categories cascade automatically by their factor. Editing an anchor rescales every category sharing that classification. Curve shapes per category stay fixed. Click "Save & generate" to write the result into race points.

model.generateConfirm: This regenerates race points from the model. Continue?

racePoints.intro: Adjust the points awarded per finishing position, per race class. Changes are audited in the admin log. Use "Reset to baseline" to restore the defaults.
racePoints.appliesToFutureHint: Saved changes only affect races imported from now on. To apply them to existing standings, run "↻ Point fra config" under the Season tab (already-paid races are left untouched).
racePoints.saved: Saved {count, plural, one {1 change} other {# changes}}
